== commands
deploy	deploy a service
help	print help
quote	values a shell must insert as one literal word

status	show status

== flags

--config	config file
--dir	work directory
--exec	program to run
--format	output format
--group	group to run as
--host	host to reach

--no-color	
--set	override a setting
--speed	how fast to go
--tag	tags to apply
--token	API token
--user	account to run as
-l	log file

== quote-all
a\ b	
it\'s\ \$HOME	
say\ \"hi\"	
`touch\ pwned`	
\$\(touch\ pwned\)	
x\;touch\ pwned	
star\*	
~root	
o’neil\;touch\ pwned	
“q”	
back\\slash	
a\\:b	
C:\\Users\\me	a path: C:\Users\me
a!b	
ends\'	
\{a,b\}	
a\&b\|c\<d\>e	
\#hash	
true	
null	
-foo.bar	
--\%	
–a.b	
-a:
